name: Fireworks AI cascade
text: One breach at an AI inference provider, then its customers: chat transcripts, driver licences and a poisoned developer extension.

name: North Korea's crypto heists
text: The record Binance theft and the deepfake FaceStealer scheme, both pinned on North Korea, and the hunt for the money.

name: ARTEX
text: An open-source agentic hacking framework that, the FBI says, criminals and Chinese state groups now use widely.

name: Cairn agents
text: China-nexus intrusions run largely by autonomous AI agents, including one that found its own zero-day.

name: Agentic attacks
text: Intrusions where AI did the work: pentest tools turned into weapons, agents hunting AI keys, an attack run end to end by AI.

name: Hit through a supplier
text: Victims breached through someone they buy from: web scripts, IT providers, shipping and payment partners, a cloud host.

name: IT providers' tools
text: Remote support and management tools of managed service providers, used to reach the customers behind them.

name: Card data vendor leak
text: One group, one supplier: customer data of Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Chase, and a claimed Walmart leak.

name: PHP2Shell
text: Two critical PHP flaws: first exploited across the web, then used to wipe servers behind Check Point gateways.

name: Cold-chain sabotage in France
text: Refrigeration controls tampered with: supermarket fridges heated to 50°C in October, plasma cold rooms set to 110°C in November.

name: The Gentlemen
text: A ransomware gang going after big names: Deloitte, then NVIDIA.

name: The FBI as target
text: Three breaches at the FBI this year: a surveillance system, applicant data, and now the national crime database.
